pr_title: Consolidate Windows cert tests to improve CI runtime
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: Pete Higgins <pete@peterhiggins.org>

Attempt to fix #10696.

These tests were identified as running slowly on CI. This PR takes their runtime from ~50s to ~18s in my local Windows 2019 VM.

issue_context.title: Determine if we can speed up the 25 minute windows certificate tests
issue_context.body: By far the worst offender in our Windows tests is the windows_certificate testing we perform. The tests in spec/functional/resource/windows_certificate_spec.rb take ~25 minutes to run in CI. Anything we can do there would be a huge win for the overall test times.
comments:
Hey @tas50 

how do I get these tests to run locally so I can look into fixing this stuff?

Thanks

review_comments: Using the `-Force` flag resulted in getting the correct results in my local testing, avoiding the need for the double command and confusing comment (`dir` and `Get-ChildItem` are aliases in powershell).
There did not seem to be a better way to allow these tests to use a custom cert folder other than stubbing this.

Reading non-binary certs with `File.binread` appears to cause no ill effects, so avoid shelling out to find out if the file is binary. This is already done in other places (#10751), so it seems safe to do here as well.
